name: Takano Miyo
source:
A nurse at the Irie Clinic, loved by everyone in the village. She has a somewhat mysterious atmosphere and always has a meaningful smile. In occult mania, she seems to be very interested in the "Oyashiro-sama" faith in Hinamizawa.

[spoiler]Takano Miyo was born [url=/c113192]Tanashi Miyoko[/url] and is the mastermind behind the Great Hinamizawa Disaster, involving the murder of [url=/c3848]Tomitake Jirou[/url], [url=/c3790]Furude Rika[/url], [url=/c3828]Irie Kyousuke[/url], and later the entire village of Hinamizawa.[/spoiler]

[Edited from [url=https://07th-expansion.fandom.com/wiki/Miyo_Takano]Miyo Takano[/url] on 07th Expansion Wiki]
